_doc: UK domestic home charging. Energy & duration lognormals fit to DfT 'Electric Chargepoint Analysis 2017: Domestics' published medians/means (energy median 7.5/mean 9.1 kWh; plug-in median 10h48m). hour_of_day_connection_hist SHAPED to the DfT-reported late-afternoon/evening plug-in peak (published chart, not per-event replay). dow near-uniform (no strong pattern reported). Behavioral persistence/adequacy cross-checked vs Electric Nation survey. NOT transaction-replayed -- calibrated from published UK summaries (per design).
source: DfT Electric Chargepoint Analysis 2017 Domestics (Open Government Licence) + Electric Nation trial
